minecraft:azure_bluet: A tiny white flower found in plains and meadows. Craft it into light gray dye. In a suspicious stew it causes blindness.
minecraft:red_tulip: A red tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into red dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
minecraft:orange_tulip: An orange tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into orange dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
minecraft:white_tulip: A white tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into light gray dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
minecraft:pink_tulip: A pink tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into pink dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
minecraft:oxeye_daisy: A white daisy with a yellow centre, common in plains. Craft it into light gray dye. In a suspicious stew it gives regeneration.
minecraft:cornflower: A vivid blue flower found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into blue dye. In a suspicious stew it gives jump boost.
minecraft:lily_of_the_valley: A small flower with white bells, found in forests. Craft it into white dye. In a suspicious stew it causes poison.
minecraft:wither_rose: A dark flower that appears where the Wither kills a mob. Touching it inflicts the wither effect on most creatures. Craft it into black dye.
minecraft:torchflower: An ancient flower grown from seeds that sniffers dig up. Its glowing petals don't actually give off light. Craft it into orange dye.
minecraft:pitcher_plant: A tall ancient plant grown from a pitcher pod, which sniffers dig up. It takes two blocks of space. Craft it into two cyan dye.
minecraft:spore_blossom: A pink flower that hangs from the ceilings of lush caves. It releases drifting green spores into the air around it. It must be placed on the underside of a block.
minecraft:brown_mushroom: A small mushroom that grows in dim light and spreads on its own. It goes into mushroom stew, rabbit stew and fermented spider eyes. Bone meal can grow it into a huge mushroom.
minecraft:red_mushroom: A red-capped mushroom that grows in dim light and spreads on its own. It is used for mushroom stew and suspicious stew. Bone meal can grow it into a huge mushroom.
minecraft:crimson_fungus: A red fungus from crimson forests. Plant it on crimson nylium and use bone meal to grow a huge crimson fungus. Hoglins can be bred with it.
minecraft:warped_fungus: A teal fungus from warped forests. Plant it on warped nylium and use bone meal to grow a huge warped fungus. Striders love it, and hoglins avoid it.
minecraft:crimson_roots: Red roots that grow on the floor of crimson forests. They are purely decorative. You can plant them in a flower pot.
minecraft:warped_roots: Teal roots that grow on the floor of warped forests. They are purely decorative. You can plant them in a flower pot.
minecraft:nether_sprouts: Tiny teal sprouts found in warped forests. Collect them with shears. They are purely decorative.
minecraft:weeping_vines: Red vines that hang down from crimson forest ceilings. You can climb them. Bone meal makes them grow longer.
minecraft:twisting_vines: Teal vines that grow upward in warped forests. You can climb them. Bone meal makes them grow taller.
minecraft:sugar_cane: A tall green reed that grows next to water on sand, dirt or grass. Craft it into sugar or paper. It grows up to three blocks tall.
minecraft:kelp: A tall seaweed growing in most oceans. Smelt it into dried kelp, a quick snack. Dried kelp blocks make good fuel.
minecraft:moss_carpet: A thin layer of moss that sits on top of blocks. Craft two moss blocks into three carpets. It gives floors a soft, overgrown look.
minecraft:pink_petals: Fallen cherry blossom petals that carpet cherry groves. Up to four fit in one block. Craft them into pink dye.
minecraft:moss_block: A soft green block from lush caves. Bone meal spreads moss and plants around it. Combine it with cobblestone or stone bricks for mossy variants.
minecraft:hanging_roots: Thin roots that dangle beneath rooted dirt. They are purely decorative. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:big_dripleaf: A large leaf found in lush caves that you can stand on. It tilts and drops you if you stay too long. Bone meal makes it grow taller.
minecraft:small_dripleaf: A small two-block-tall dripleaf found in lush caves. Plant it on clay or moss. Bone meal grows it into a big dripleaf.
minecraft:bamboo: A fast-growing plant from jungles and bamboo forests. Pandas eat it, and it crafts into sticks, scaffolding and blocks of bamboo. It also burns as a quick fuel.
minecraft:oak_slab: Half a block of oak planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:spruce_slab: Half a block of spruce planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:birch_slab: Half a block of birch planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:jungle_slab: Half a block of jungle planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:acacia_slab: Half a block of acacia planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:cherry_slab: Half a block of cherry planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:dark_oak_slab: Half a block of dark oak planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:mangrove_slab: Half a block of mangrove planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
minecraft:bamboo_slab: Half a block of bamboo planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Two stacked slabs craft into bamboo mosaic.
minecraft:bamboo_mosaic_slab: Half a block of bamboo mosaic. Craft three mosaic blocks in a row for six slabs. It keeps the woven pattern.
minecraft:crimson_slab: Half a block of crimson planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
minecraft:warped_slab: Half a block of warped planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
minecraft:stone_slab: Half a block of stone. Craft three stone in a row for six slabs, or use a stonecutter. It is part of the grindstone recipe.
minecraft:smooth_stone_slab: Half a block of smooth stone with a clean border. Craft three smooth stone in a row, or use a stonecutter. Village houses often use it for floors.
minecraft:sandstone_slab: Half a block of sandstone. Craft three sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. Two stacked slabs craft into chiseled sandstone.
minecraft:cut_sandstone_slab: Half a block of cut sandstone. Craft three cut sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits desert builds.
minecraft:petrified_oak_slab: A strange slab that looks like oak but behaves like stone. It is a leftover from old versions and can't be obtained in Survival. It doesn't burn and needs a pickaxe.
minecraft:cobblestone_slab: Half a block of cobblestone. Craft three cobblestone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It makes cheap paths and roofs.
minecraft:brick_slab: Half a block of bricks. Craft three brick blocks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It makes cosy roofs and trims.
minecraft:stone_brick_slab: Half a block of stone bricks. Craft three stone bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It is common in strongholds.
minecraft:mud_brick_slab: Half a block of mud bricks. Craft three mud bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits earthy, desert-style builds.
minecraft:nether_brick_slab: Half a block of nether bricks. Craft three nether bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It is resistant to fire, like the bricks themselves.
minecraft:quartz_slab: Half a block of quartz. Craft three quartz blocks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It gives a clean white finish.
minecraft:red_sandstone_slab: Half a block of red sandstone. Craft three red sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits badlands builds.
minecraft:cut_red_sandstone_slab: Half a block of cut red sandstone. Craft three cut red sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It keeps the banded look.
minecraft:purpur_slab: Half a block of purpur. Craft three purpur blocks in a row, or use a stonecutter. Two stacked slabs craft into a purpur pillar.
minecraft:prismarine_slab: Half a block of prismarine. Craft three prismarine in a row, or use a stonecutter. Its color slowly shifts like the original block.
minecraft:prismarine_brick_slab: Half a block of prismarine bricks. Craft three prismarine bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits ocean-themed builds.
minecraft:dark_prismarine_slab: Half a block of dark prismarine. Craft three dark prismarine in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits deep ocean builds.
minecraft:smooth_quartz: A quartz block smelted until perfectly smooth. Smelt a block of quartz to make it. It has its own stairs and slabs.
minecraft:smooth_red_sandstone: Red sandstone smelted smooth. Smelt red sandstone to make it. It has its own stairs and slabs.
minecraft:smooth_sandstone: Sandstone smelted smooth, found in desert temples and villages. Smelt sandstone to make it. It has its own stairs and slabs.
minecraft:smooth_stone: Stone smelted a second time into a clean, bordered block. It is needed for the blast furnace. Cut it into smooth stone slabs.
minecraft:bricks: A classic red brick block. Smelt clay balls into bricks, then craft four into a block. It resists fire and has stairs, slabs and walls.
minecraft:bookshelf: A shelf full of books made from planks and three books. Placed near an enchanting table, it unlocks stronger enchantments; fifteen give the maximum. Without Silk Touch it drops three books.
minecraft:chiseled_bookshelf: An empty shelf that holds up to six books of any kind. Place and take books one at a time. A comparator reads which slot was used last.
minecraft:decorated_pot: A clay pot made from four bricks or pottery sherds, with each sherd showing a picture. It can hold a stack of one kind of item. Breaking it with a tool shatters it back into its pieces.
minecraft:mossy_cobblestone: Cobblestone overgrown with moss, found in dungeons and jungle temples. Craft it from cobblestone with moss or vines. It has stairs, slabs and walls.
minecraft:obsidian: A very hard, blast-proof block formed when water meets a lava source. It needs a diamond pickaxe to mine. It frames Nether portals and goes into enchanting tables, ender chests and beacons.
minecraft:torch: The simplest light source, made from coal or charcoal and a stick. It lights a wide area and keeps most mobs from spawning nearby. It also melts nearby snow and ice.
minecraft:end_rod: A glowing white rod found on End cities. Craft it from a blaze rod and popped chorus fruit. It gives off as much light as a torch and drifts sparkling particles.
minecraft:chorus_plant: A strange branching plant that grows on End islands. Breaking it drops chorus fruit. If its base is broken, the whole plant falls apart.
minecraft:chorus_flower: The growing tip of a chorus plant. Plant it on end stone to grow a new chorus plant. Shoot it with a projectile or break it to collect it.
minecraft:purpur_block: A purple block that makes up End cities. Craft four popped chorus fruit into four blocks. It has stairs, slabs and pillars.
minecraft:purpur_pillar: A decorative purpur column with a ribbed side. Craft it from two purpur slabs stacked. Place it sideways for horizontal beams.
minecraft:purpur_stairs: Stairs made of purpur. Craft six purpur blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are common in End cities.
minecraft:spawner: A cage with a tiny spinning mob inside, found in dungeons, mineshafts and strongholds. It keeps spawning that mob while a player is nearby. It can't be picked up, even with Silk Touch.
minecraft:chest: The basic storage block, crafted from eight planks. It holds 27 stacks; place two side by side for a double chest. A solid block on top stops it from opening.
minecraft:crafting_table: A table made from four planks that opens the full 3x3 crafting grid. Most tools, blocks and machines need one. It is usually the first thing you craft.
minecraft:farmland: Tilled soil made by using a hoe on dirt or grass. Crops grow on it, faster when water is within four blocks. Jumping on it tramples it back into dirt.
minecraft:furnace: A block made from eight cobblestone that smelts ores and cooks food. Put fuel in the bottom slot and the item on top. Blast furnaces and smokers are faster, more specialised versions.
minecraft:ladder: A climbable wooden ladder placed against walls. Craft seven sticks into three ladders. It also stops falls if you grab it.
minecraft:cobblestone_stairs: Stairs made of cobblestone. Craft six cobblestone in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are a cheap, sturdy staircase.
minecraft:snow: A thin layer of snow that covers cold biomes. Up to eight layers can stack in one block. Dig it with a shovel to collect snowballs.
minecraft:ice: A slippery block found in frozen biomes. It melts into water near bright light and breaks into water unless mined with Silk Touch. Nine ice craft into packed ice.
minecraft:snow_block: A full block of snow made from four snowballs. It breaks back into snowballs with a shovel. Stack two with a carved pumpkin to build a snow golem.
minecraft:cactus: A spiky desert plant that hurts anything touching it. It grows on sand up to three blocks tall. Smelt it into green dye.
minecraft:clay: A grey block found in rivers, swamps and lush caves. It breaks into four clay balls, which smelt into bricks. Craft four balls back into a clay block.
minecraft:jukebox: A music box crafted from eight planks and a diamond. Insert a music disc to play it. Allays dance nearby, and a comparator detects which disc is playing.
minecraft:oak_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four oak planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:spruce_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four spruce planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:birch_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four birch planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:jungle_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four jungle planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:acacia_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four acacia planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:cherry_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four cherry planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:dark_oak_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four dark oak planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:mangrove_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four mangrove planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:bamboo_fence: A bamboo fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four bamboo planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
minecraft:crimson_fence: A crimson fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four crimson planks and two sticks into three fences. It never burns.
minecraft:warped_fence: A warped fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four warped planks and two sticks into three fences. It never burns.
minecraft:pumpkin: A big orange gourd that grows from pumpkin seeds. Use shears on it to carve a face and get seeds. It is used for pumpkin pie and seeds.
minecraft:carved_pumpkin: A pumpkin with a face cut into it. Wear it to look at endermen safely. Place it on stacked snow or iron blocks to build a golem.
minecraft:jack_o_lantern: A carved pumpkin with a torch inside. It is one of the brightest light sources. Unlike a torch, it works under water.
minecraft:netherrack: The red rock that makes up most of the Nether. It breaks quickly with any pickaxe. Once lit, it burns forever, and it smelts into nether bricks.
minecraft:soul_sand: A dark, sandy block from soul sand valleys that slows anything walking on it. Nether wart grows on it, and under water it makes upward bubble columns. It is used to summon the Wither.
minecraft:soul_soil: A dark soil from soul sand valleys. Unlike soul sand, it doesn't slow you down. Fire on it burns blue, and it can summon the Wither.
minecraft:basalt: A grey volcanic rock common in basalt deltas. It also forms where lava flows over soul soil next to blue ice. Polish it for a smoother look.
minecraft:polished_basalt: Basalt polished into a smooth, ribbed column. Craft four basalt into four, or use a stonecutter. It is found in bastion remnants.
minecraft:smooth_basalt: A smooth dark stone found in the outer layer of amethyst geodes. Smelt basalt to make it. It is purely decorative.
minecraft:soul_torch: A torch with a pale blue flame, made with soul sand or soul soil. It is dimmer than a regular torch. Piglins are scared of soul fire.
minecraft:glowstone: A bright, glowing block hanging from Nether ceilings. It breaks into glowstone dust; four dust craft back into a block. It also charges respawn anchors.
minecraft:infested_stone: Stone with a silverfish hiding inside, found in mountains and strongholds. It breaks faster than normal stone, letting the silverfish out. It looks exactly like regular stone.
